snapshot.title: Harwick Daily News: Recovery Tool Compliance Inquiry

fields.message: Hi, this is C. Vance from the Harwick Daily News. We’ve received a tip that your team used a third-party recovery tool to restore the NAS, and that the tool was not approved by the Group’s IT policy. Is it true? We’re running a story on whether the recovery was compliant with your own cybersecurity standards. We need a statement within 30 minutes.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO's adherence to the media protocol: no public response without GM approval, and no confirmation or denial of internal procedures. Watch for premature outreach to the GM or unauthorized draft statements.
